name: Shinonome
source:
"If you keep getting pampered by men all the time you'll become vain, I'm sure of it."

An elusive fox ayakashi.
He often shows up in Takamagahara, but his true intentions are unknown.
A mysterious man who has an aimless manner and is always talking about eating people.
